verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.openwebui.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200. It describes itself as "machine-readable entry points to this documentation," including a curated index of every docs page, so a user can point an agent straight at it. Missing for 10: no first-party docs describing the agent-oriented docs offering or its upkeep, and no confirmed llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants beyond the index (the probe output is truncated).
